title: DCKV: Learned Transform Coding of the Prompt KV Cache in Hybrid Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.36950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hybrid language models keep a key-value (KV) cache only in their few full-attention layers, but this cache is still the part of a prompt's state that grows with the prompt and that must be stored or moved to reuse it. We present DCKV, a differentiable codec for the KV cache and the first KV-cache codec that is trained end to end. Its transform, its quantizer and its entropy models, which are conditioned on the prompt tokens and on already decoded neighbouring positions, are optimized together against the frozen language model, both for the code length that the entropy models assign and for the change of the model's output. On Qwen3.5-2B, DCKV stores a compressed token in more than 55 times fewer bytes than bf16 at a loss of at most 1.8 points on three long-context benchmarks, and in more than 100 times fewer bytes at a loss of at most 3.6 points.

translated_title: DCKV：混合语言模型中提示词KV缓存的学习式变换编码
translated_abstract: 混合语言模型仅在少数几个全注意力层中保留键值（KV）缓存，但该缓存仍然是提示词状态中随提示词长度增长的部分，并且为了复用必须被存储或传输。我们提出了DCKV，一种针对KV缓存的可微分编解码器，也是首个端到端训练的KV缓存编解码器。其变换、量化器和熵模型（以提示词token及已解码的相邻位置为条件）针对冻结的语言模型进行联合优化，同时优化熵模型所分配的码长以及模型输出的变化。在Qwen3.5-2B上，DCKV存储每个压缩token所需字节数比bf16少55倍以上，且在三个长上下文基准测试上性能损失至多1.8分；所需字节数比bf16少100倍以上时，性能损失至多3.6分。
tldr: DCKV是首个端到端训练的KV缓存可微分编解码器，可在三个长上下文基准上以不超过1.8分的性能损失，将混合语言模型的提示词KV缓存压缩到比bf16少55倍以上的存储空间。
